text:
evan: Heads up — sample-app telemetry flagged a lot of confusion around HTTP error semantics. Folks are getting 401s and 429s and the SDKs are giving inconsistent signals. 401 -> UnauthorizedError (no retry hint) in JS, but Go surfaces a generic StatusCodeException. Too noisy. :thinking:
maria: Ugh. We saw this in onboarding sessions. Users don't know whether to refresh tokens or backoff. The lack of structured retry_hint is the big UX gap.
samir: Proposal: unify the error surface across SDKs to a small typed set plus structured fields. Something like:
  - type: string (e.g. "UnauthorizedError")
  - status: number
  - retryable: boolean
  - retry_after_seconds?: number
  - hint?: string
  Keep it flat so language idioms map easily.
olivia: We hit a conversion drop in the sample app — about 8% of signups failed because UI just showed "Unauthorized" with no action. If we include a clear `hint` like "refresh token" it's much better.
kevin: Implementation details: the server sometimes sends `Retry-After` as seconds or as HTTP-date. We need runtime parsing and normalization to seconds. Also for quota errors we might want a quota bucket id in metadata.
ev an: Quick mapping idea to start discussion:
  400 -> BadRequestError (retryable: false)
  401 -> UnauthorizedError (retryable: depends: expired_token -> true with hint "refresh_token", revoked -> false)
  403 -> PermissionError (retryable: false)
  404 -> NotFoundError (retryable: false)
  408, 429, 503 -> TransientError / RateLimitedError (retryable: true, include retry_after_seconds when header present)
  5xx -> ServerError (retryable: true for 502/503/504)
maria: Love that. We should also expose an `intent` string for UI consumption e.g. "refresh_credentials", "backoff_and_retry", "contact_support" so frontends can pick an action instead of guessing.
samir: Example JS shape we can publish in the spec:
```js
throw new RateLimitedError({
  message: 'rate limit exceeded',
  status: 429,
  retryable: true,
  retry_after_seconds: 30,
  intent: 'backoff_and_retry',
  hint: 'reduce request rate or use a larger batch'
});
```
olivia: For OAuth flows: if body contains `error_description` or `error = invalid_token` we should map to UnauthorizedError with hint parsed. If `reason: user_revoked` flag then mark retryable=false and intent=contact_support.
kevin: Edge case: streaming endpoints sometimes return an error frame with status 200 but JSON body {error:{code:429}}. Need to normalize in client parser so we still throw typed errors.
maria: I'll add a test matrix across python/js/go with these vectors. Also sample-app will show how to map `intent` -> UX.
docs-bot: Docs task created: "SDK error contract: typed exceptions + retry hints" assigned to @maria, due in 1 week.
ev an: For rollout we should do a canary in dev first. deploy-bot: Canary for devex-sdk-js v2.3.1 scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC :shipit:
maria: Will PR mapping table + sample-app UI changes. Tagging @samir for runtime header parsing and @kevin for edge cases.
samir: One more: include machine-readable `code` enum (e.g., "rate_limit") in addition to human `message` so infra can filter.
kevin: Agreed. That will help SLO dashboards.
ev an: Thanks all — I'll open the RFC draft with the proposed table + sample snippets. Please drop test vectors in that PR. :+1:
